result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but one section header displays a raw localization key instead of translated text, which is a clear content defect. Other partially visible elements (right-edge carousel item, bottom card) are expected scroll behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: The section header above the ramen card shows the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable translated title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing or failed localization string.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key in the relevant locale files and ensure the localization pipeline resolves it before rendering; add a fallback so a friendly default title shows if the key is absent.
